description: This file contains functions and data structures for managing database schema creation and retrieval for the opencart project, including table definitions for various entities such as products, categories, users, and other core components.

methods.name: oc_db_create
methods.description: Creates or updates the database schema based on predefined table structures, dropping existing tables if they exist, and creating new tables with specified fields, primary keys, indexes, and foreign keys.

methods.name: oc_db_schema
methods.description: Returns an array defining the schema for various tables used in the opencart project, including their fields, primary keys, indexes, and table options.
